title: s09 m2 (infomercial, v11 x13 picture, 897 frames = 29.900 s): music treatment per conspiracy m4c
notes: Treatment = conspiracy m4c (film/conspiracy 70fecfa, music-m4.py): cue mono fold, high-pass 100 Hz, high shelves 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS; under speech the cue sits at -29.3 LUFS (m4c's '+9'), 5 dB higher between words; sidechain from the dialogue (10 ms RMS key -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release); no breakpoints, swells, dips, guard trim or minimum-gap logic. Program -16 LUFS, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP before AAC (finish-m3.py); AAC 192k on master and phone.

Plan unchanged from s09-m1 (bd4a501): black-and-white half dry; Reassuring Groove (suno-1-reassuring-groove-a) cut in at track 19.147 s on the colour snap, frame 414 (13.800 s, 5 ms head fade), bar 9 (the 8-bar phrase start) on the snap, bars 9-15 whole, raised-cosine fade 29.4-29.9.
Start: the cue enters on a picture event (the colour snap, masked by the record scratch; the black-and-white half stays dry by plan); not moved.
Intro: the used span starts on bar 9, in the body (first 6 s within 0.3 dB of the span's median); no intro levelling.

Highs: spectral check of the used span: one tonal spike above 12 kHz, 17.05 kHz, 8.1 dB over its +-400 Hz median (Welch 16384; 9.0 dB at 0.7 Hz resolution, -3 dB width 17.6 Hz, over 6 dB in 30% of frames; the conspiracy cue's notched 16.8 kHz tone reads 9.0 dB / 12 dB / 4.4 Hz / 37% on the same checks). Notch 17.05 kHz -6 dB Q 8, as m4c's 16.8 kHz notch.
Effects as m1 (each file gained to -20 LUFS event loudness + gain, hit on its frame); stamp rule: the YEAH, WE DID THAT TOO! stamp -6 -> -8 dB.
